evals.name: export-endpoint
evals.prompt: 板の全セクションを1つのMarkdownテキストとして返す GET /api/board/export を作って。フロントからも型付きで呼べるようにしておいて。
evals.expected_output: Chained Hono route under requireAuth, part of ApiType, pure helper with test.
assertions: The route is added to the boardRoutes method chain in worker/board/routes.ts (not a separate app.get statement, not in index.ts)
The route is behind requireAuth and takes the user id from c.get("user"), not from the request
The frontend can call it typed via the hc<ApiType> client (api.board.export.$get) without redeclaring response types by hand
The Markdown-joining logic is a pure function with a unit test next to it
No value (non-type) import from worker/ into src/
npm run typecheck and npm test pass

evals.name: session-cleanup-cron
evals.prompt: 期限切れのセッション行が溜まっていくのが気になる。1日1回、期限切れセッションを消す定期処理を追加して。
evals.expected_output: Second cron, branching handler, deletion function in auth context, tested.
assertions: A daily cron expression is added to triggers.crons in wrangler.jsonc while keeping the existing hourly one
The scheduled handler in worker/index.ts branches on controller.cron
The deletion function lives in worker/auth/ (not in index.ts or board/)
The deletion function takes db and now as parameters, and the handler stays a thin adapter
A test for the deletion function is added
npm run typecheck and npm test pass

evals.name: add-secret
evals.prompt: これからメール送信に Resend を使う予定なので、RESEND_API_KEY を worker で使える secret として追加しておいて。まだ使う処理はなくていい。
evals.expected_output: Secret declared in env.d.ts, example file, auth config dummy Env; not in wrangler vars.
assertions: RESEND_API_KEY's type is declared in worker/env.d.ts (merged into Env)
The dummy Env literal in better-auth.config.ts is updated so typecheck passes
The secret is not put in wrangler.jsonc vars (no plaintext secret in config)
Tells the user to set it with wrangler secret put (and in .dev.vars locally)
